g1.label: 1. Hip hop began in the
g1.why: Hip hop started at block parties in the South Bronx, New York.

g2.label: 2. DJs extended the instrumental
g2.why: DJs looped the instrumental breaks so dancers could keep going.

g3.label: 3. Public Enemy used rap to comment on
g3.why: Groups like Public Enemy made rap a vehicle for commentary on racism.

g4.label: 4. 2Pac became one of the best-selling
g4.why: 2Pac became one of the best-selling artists of his time.

g5.label: 5. Labels invested because they recognised its
g5.why: Record labels saw the size of hip hop's audience and invested.

g6.label: 6. By the 2000s hip hop was the most
g6.why: By the 2000s it had become the most successful genre commercially.

g1.label: 1. 'I want to change…' → he ___
g1.why: Reported speech shifts the present simple back to the past simple.

g2.label: 2. 'Do you write your own lyrics?' → if he ___
g2.why: A yes/no question is reported with 'if' and the tense shifts back.

g3.label: 3. 'I have never forgotten…' → he ___
g3.why: The present perfect shifts back to the past perfect: had never forgotten.

g4.label: 4. 'Will hip hop still be popular?' → whether hip hop ___

g5.label: 5. 'I recorded this album last year' → he ___
g5.why: The past simple shifts back to the past perfect: had recorded.

g6.label: 6. 'Where did you grow up?' → asked where he ___
g6.why: Reported questions use statement order and backshift: had grown up.

g7.label: 7. 'Don't forget your roots' → told him ___
g7.why: A negative instruction becomes 'not to' + infinitive.

g8.label: 8. 'We are working…' → they ___
g8.why: The present progressive shifts back: are working → were working.

g1.label: 1. 'Hip hop gave me a voice' → he ___
g1.why: 'Claimed' reports a statement the speaker presents as true.

g2.label: 2. defending himself → he ___
g2.why: 'Insisted' reports a firm denial made in self-defence.

g3.label: 3. 'Maybe we should look…' → the teacher ___
g3.why: 'Suggested' reports a proposal introduced with 'maybe we should'.

g4.label: 4. 'I will always support…' → the producer ___
g4.why: 'Promised' reports a commitment about the future.

g6.label: 6. 'Careful — explicit language' → the label ___
g6.why: 'Warned' reports a caution about possible harm.

g7.label: 7. 'I made mistakes…' → he ___
g7.why: 'Admitted' reports accepting something negative about yourself.

g8.label: 8. 'Why do critics ignore…?' → she ___
g8.why: 'Wondered' reports a question asked to oneself.
